title: Killer Pietro
altTitles: El Viejito que rejuveneció porque le robaron los riales
นักฆ่าย้อนวัย
コードネーム：バッドロー
description: Peter, a legendary assassin who devoted his life to the crime organization Glory Club, retires and spends his remaining years quietly running a used bookstore. When the organization he served betrays him and nearly kills him, his body mysteriously reverts to his teenage years. With his youthful body restored but his decades of assassination experience intact, Peter sets out to settle the score with Glory Club and reclaim his place at the top.
author: Kim Junghyun
